problem: 133 pre-1867 career events (130 CO, 3 IOL) were grounded to modern Canada (Q16), whose Wikidata inception is 1867; 12 more had Q16 as colony for Charlottetown, Kingston, Lytton and Mackenzie River. Found via the WHG gazetteer out-of-period screen (e.g. Griffin, deputy postmaster-general's office, 'Canada, 24th April, 1831').
rule: Printed 'Canada' with event year <= 1840 -> The Canadas (Q7721124, crown colony 1791-1841, has parts Upper Canada Q795427 and Lower Canada Q1134180); 1841-1866 -> Province of Canada (Q1121436); 1867+ unchanged (Q16). A bare 'Canada' cannot say which of Upper or Lower Canada was meant, so the collective colony is used rather than guessing.
